CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content is asserted; A is absent.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an explicit organization/access origin field, and a separate status/field distinction are all present for the same current referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim is linked to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies color-labeled contents (red/blue) with explicit coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Content sets are listed separately from explicit origin/access/status metadata for the same referent.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/access fields describe how the listed content instances are presented or derived.
